Cognitive function declines linked to poor sleep quality highlight the importance of sleep for brain health. Sleep facilitates synaptic plasticity, crucial for memory consolidation. Results reveal that sleep disturbances can predict cognitive decline, suggesting long-term implications for cognitive health. A self-study protocol can help explore your sleep patterns and their effects. (Tucker et al., 2024)
